findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "lock_check" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Check locks on a component ($0.01/query x402 — send the payment as the X-PAYMENT header on the JSON-RPC POST, same authorization format as REST)

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lock_check · Private data: place_lock · Public sink: lock_check · Destructive: lock_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lock_check · Private data: place_lock · Public sink: lock_check · Destructive: lock_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
